title: Blueberry extract and its bioactive compounds mitigate oxidative stress and suppress human lung cancer cell (A549) growth by modulating the expression of p53/EGFR/STAT3/IL6-mediated signaling molecules.
authors: Krishnamoorthy, Kalaiselvi; Natarajan, Sathan Raj; Veeraraghavan, Vishnu Priya; Jayaraman, Selvaraj
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蓝莓提取物及其活性成分对肺癌细胞的抗氧化和细胞毒性作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白激酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Bioactive phytocompounds are crucial components in all plants. Since the time of traditional medicine, the utilization of plants has been grounded in the potential of these bioactive compounds to treat or manage specific illnesses. These natural bioactive compounds have sparked growing interest in employing medicinal plants for addressing various conditions, such as inflammatory diseases, diabetes, and cancer. This study focuses on assessing the qualitative phytochemical composition, antioxidant potential, and cytotoxic effects of blueberry (Vaccinium sect. Cyanococcus) extract using three different solvents, namely water, ethanol, and methanol. The extract exhibited notable antioxidant activities, as evidenced by DPPH and H(2)O(2) free radical scavenging assays. The cell viability assay also demonstrated cell growth inhibition in A549 cells. Furthermore, nine specific phytocompounds sourced from existing literature were selected for molecular docking studies against CDK6 and, AMPK key protein kinases which enhance the cancer progression. The molecular docking results also revealed favorable binding scores, with a high score of -9.5 kcal/mol in CDK6 protein and a maximum score of AMPK with targets of -8.8 kcal/mol. The selected phytocompounds' pharmacodynamic properties such as ADMET also supported the study. Furthermore, rutin stated that pre-dominantly present in blueberry plants shows a potent cytotoxicity effect in A549 cells. Functional annotations by bioinformatic analysis for rutin also revealed the strong enrichment in the involvement of PI3K/AKT1/STAT, and p53 signaling pathways. Based on this analysis, the identified rutin and other compounds hold a promising anticancer activity. Overall, the comprehensive evaluation of both in vitro and in silico data suggests that the Vaccinium sect. Cyanococcus extract could serve as a valuable source of pharmaceutical agents and may prove effective in future therapeutic applications.
abstract_zh: 生物活性植物化合物是所有植物中的重要组成部分。自传统医学时代以来，植物的利用便基于这些生物活性化合物治疗或管理特定疾病的潜力。这些天然生物活性化合物引发了人们对利用药用植物应对各种疾病（如炎症性疾病、糖尿病和癌症）的日益关注。本研究旨在使用三种不同溶剂（即水、乙醇和甲醇）评估蓝莓（Vaccinium sect. Cyanococcus）提取物的定性植物化学成分、抗氧化潜力和细胞毒性效应。该提取物表现出显著的抗氧化活性，这通过DPPH和H(2)O(2)自由基清除实验得以证实。细胞活力实验也显示了对A549细胞的生长抑制作用。此外，从现有文献中选取了九种特定植物化合物，针对CDK6和AMPK关键蛋白激酶（这些激酶促进癌症进展）进行分子对接研究。分子对接结果也揭示了有利的结合分数，其中CDK6蛋白的高分为-9.5 kcal/mol，AMPK与靶标的最大分数为-8.8 kcal/mol。所选植物化合物的药效学特性（如ADMET）也支持了本研究。此外，芦丁（rutin）被指出主要存在于蓝莓植物中，在A549细胞中显示出强效的细胞毒性效应。通过生物信息学分析对芦丁进行的功能注释也揭示了其在PI3K/AKT1/STAT和p53信号通路参与中的强烈富集。基于此分析，所识别的芦丁及其他化合物具有有前景的抗癌活性。总体而言，对体外和计算机模拟数据的综合评估表明，Vaccinium sect. Cyanococcus提取物可作为药物制剂的有价值来源，并可能在未来的治疗应用中证明有效。
